_comment: Forever Party Rentals — Event Layout Planner starter templates. Generated from planner/layout-gen.js so Templates and Plan-for-me share the same packing (honeycomb rounds, fewest marquees, dance in a corner). intimate-wedding-20 and birthday-30 stay hand-built (joined head-table runs). Coordinates are item centers in feet; withChairs:true tables get auto-chairs via placeChairsAround().
